findings.title: TestLogger.FromContext discards recorded logs
findings.body: FromContext returns a brand-new TestLogger instead of the receiver or a logger sharing the receiver's recording state. LoggerMiddleware now logs through m.logger.FromContext(ctx), so a test that constructs it with a TestLogger and then inspects that original fake will always see zero InfoLogs and cannot verify the "Plugin Request Completed" log; the log is written to a discarded instance. FromContext should return the receiver (or a derived logger sharing the same Logs state).

findings.title: No test covers contextual-logger propagation to LoggerMiddleware
findings.body: This PR moves instrumentContext into a new middleware and makes LoggerMiddleware depend on it (it now obtains pluginId/endpoint/dsName/dsUID/uname only via logger.FromContext(ctx) instead of explicit log parameters), but no test is added for ContextualLoggerMiddleware and the renamed metrics test only asserts Prometheus metrics. A regression in instrumentContext (wrong endpoint/attributes) or in the middleware ordering in CreateMiddlewares would silently drop those fields from "Plugin Request Completed" logs without any test failing. Add a test that runs ContextualLoggerMiddleware before LoggerMiddleware and asserts the emitted log carries the contextual attributes.
